title: And God created woman (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
Juliette Hardy is an eighteen years old orphan, sexually active and ahead of time. She has a crush on Antoine Tardieu, but he just wants to have one nightstand with her. When Juliette's stepparents decide to send her back to the orphanage, Antoine's brother Michel Tardieu
proposes to marry her and she accepts. As she begins to love him, Antoine returns to St. Tropez, and her lust for him blossoms again and becomes an announced tragedy.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Juliette Hardy 是個十八歲的孤兒，性活躍且早熟的她，暗戀上 Antoine Tardieu，但對方只想跟她來一場一夜情。當 Juliette 的繼父母決定把她送回孤兒院時，Antoine 的弟弟 Michel Tardieu 向她求婚，她答應了。當她逐漸愛上他時，Antoine 回到聖特羅佩，她對他的慾望再度萌生，最終演變成一場早已註定的悲劇。
